# Sources

The catalogue contains 57 sources. 5 have material in this repository. 36 of 229 recorded witness readings await checks in print.

Citation recovery is incomplete in 77 of 77 glossary entries. Glossary links show the citations recorded so far.

The excavated readings here are individual facts. A qualifying transcription can be admitted under the [source policy](PROVENANCE.md#excavated).
